slides.texte_overlay:
Man to Man
This is how you move on
properly (Part 2)

1. Archive the photos
Don't delete them in anger.
Just move them out of sight.
You don't need a daily reminder.

2. Change the soundtrack
New playlist.
The old songs keep
the old feelings alive.

3. Don't check if they've
moved on
Whatever you find
won't help you heal.

4. Keep your nights early
Late nights are when
it hits hardest.
Sleep is part of healing.

5. Write the letter.
Don't send it.
Say everything once.
Then close the notebook.

6. Grow something
that's only yours
A new skill, a new subject.
Something that has nothing
to do with the past.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Grow something
that's only yours
I swap my late-night scroll

One story from history,
one idea from science.
